decisions.statement: n8n owns flow (sequencing, retry timeline, approval timelines, when an LLM is asked); the host owns authority, execution and evidence.
decisions.scope: every workflow and every host service in the fabric (relay, gateway, executor, ledger, comms, bridge)
decisions.accountable_owner_role: process owner + platform owner (ROLE to confirm); sole graph owner per process
alternatives_rejected: n8n as pure scheduler (keeps flow in shell)
n8n as authority (secrets and live/dry in a UI-editable tool)
decisions.authority_impact: moves no authority to n8n; n8n gains flow control only
decisions.acceptance_criteria: one bounded business process with reviewed scope and output SLA, graph-owned flow (branch/retry/wait), old orchestration retired or fenced, every remaining trigger honours the semantic contract, correlated output plus failure/recovery/delivery evidence (audit section 14 'Count a business process only after acceptance')

runtime_evidence.evidence: dated gap assessment 02:35Z: zero business processes owned by n8n; hermes learning committed and inactive

decisions.proof_required: first accepted process: deployment manifest at served SHA, scoped canary receipts, target-effect proof, failure/recovery drill, rollback

decisions.statement: One door: n8n reaches the host only through the bearer relay, which re-signs each call as a short-lived HMAC claim to the coordination gateway; the HMAC key never enters n8n.
decisions.authority_impact: defines the complete host surface n8n can reach; adding a route widens n8n authority
decisions.acceptance_criteria: one route definition drives relay dispatch, catalogue and checker; exact methods/origin/auth; firewall check for 172.19.0.1:18092; positive and negative method/path, duplicate-key and redirect tests; no side door by token addition

runtime_evidence.evidence: ss -ltn 13:03Z: relay LISTEN 172.19.0.1:18092; gateway LISTEN 127.0.0.1:18091 only

decisions.proof_required: eight handlers = ROUTES = relay contract catalogue (GET /momentum-lifecycle is served outside ROUTES today); firewall evidence; negative route tests

decisions.statement: Refusals are data: a policy refusal is a typed outcome, not an n8n error.
decisions.scope: gateway refusals, executor RUN_REFUSED, Run Lane outcome handling
decisions.accountable_owner_role: process owner + protocol owner (ROLE to confirm)
decisions.authority_impact: none directly; prevents real failures drowning in refusal noise
decisions.acceptance_criteria: typed refusal preserved end to end; a persistent refusal that stalls required business output is measured and escalated by impact; legacy dispatcher no longer raises refusals as errors

decisions.statement: Run Lane is the only business retry owner.

decisions.statement: Semantic effect key across schedulers (cron and n8n), not lock-only protection.

decisions.authority_impact: gates whether a live effect may run at all

decisions.statement: Empty success is a failure: exit 0 is not evidence of work.

decisions.accountable_owner_role: contract owner + verifier owner (ROLE to confirm)
decisions.authority_impact: decides what counts as a successful run in the audit of record

decisions.statement: n8n LLM processes route OAuth first (grok, then chatgpt), DeepSeek on OAuth failure or for higher reasoning (declared reasoning_tier high, or one capped escalation on a low-confidence OAuth answer).
decisions.scope: every n8n-coordination LLM process and every LLM step an n8n fabric process calls
decisions.authority_impact: selects which provider serves an n8n LLM step and when a metered escalation is spent; grants no new route or credential

ratification.ref: in terms of n8n, then, we should try OAuth first. And if OAuth fails or if the answer needs higher reasoning, then we go to DeepSeek.

decisions.acceptance_criteria: served release routes each n8n process grok -> chatgpt -> DeepSeek with route receipts; reasoning_tier high serves DeepSeek PRO_THINK first; at most one capped escalation; operator 4-path proof (< $0.05) recorded
decisions.proof_required: operator proof after release: OAuth serves; DeepSeek fallback with OAuth disabled; low-confidence escalation; reasoning_tier high
